title: Unattributed CPU gap (uninstrumented code / OS stall)
fix_rationale: The trace shows time elapsed on the GameThread where no active profiled Unreal scopes exist. This occurs when uninstrumented C++ code, third-party libraries, OS thread preemption, or page faults stall execution.
evidence_template: The GameThread spent {ms} ms with no active profiled Unreal scopes ({share}% of extra frame time).

fixes.text: Add TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE macros around suspect C++ functions, tick loops, and third-party libraries.
Add your project root and engine folders to Windows Defender / Antivirus exclusions.
Set Windows Power Plan to 'High Performance' to prevent CPU core clock throttling or parking.

verify: Re-capture a trace with added trace scopes to resolve the unprofiled timing gap into concrete functions.
caveats: Represents time spent outside instrumented Unreal Engine timers (e.g. unprofiled native code, OS scheduling, or hardware latency).
